subject.title: fix: add main agent config protection at validation, startup, and doctor layers

question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting custom default-agent IDs, or intentionally make a literal `main` entry mandatory in every explicit agents list?
rationale: Current source and documentation support custom default IDs, while this PR would replace that shipped configuration contract with a stricter invariant and automatic config mutation.

options.title: Protect effective default
options.body: Keep custom default IDs supported and address accidental displacement through explicit-default validation, warnings, and a doctor repair for ambiguous configurations.

options.title: Require literal main
options.body: Deliberately change the configuration contract, with migration, documentation, upgrade proof, and clear operator-facing recovery before enforcing the new invariant.

recommendation.title: Protect effective default
recommendation.body: Keep custom default IDs supported and address accidental displacement through explicit-default validation, warnings, and a doctor repair for ambiguous configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Gateway configuration contract, doctor migration ownership, and documented multi-agent behavior.
